list.name: Optics
list.blurb: Repairs, teardowns, alignment, and the occasional argument with a stage controller.
list.intro: Repairs, teardowns, alignment, and the occasional argument with a stage controller.
list.empty: Bench notes from working on Olympus, Nikon, Leica and Zeiss platforms — what broke, what it turned out to be, and what I would check first next time.

list.name: On Screen
list.blurb: Rating lab equipment in film and television. Right instrument? Used correctly? Could they possibly be seeing that?
list.intro: Rating lab equipment in film and television.
list.empty: Every entry gets scored on the same three axes: is it the right instrument for the setting, is anyone using it correctly, and could they plausibly be seeing what the script says they are seeing.

list.name: The Bench
list.blurb: Things made and things brought back — restorations, prints, builds, and works in progress.
list.intro: Things made and things brought back.
list.empty: Restorations, prints, builds and half-finished projects. Lamps, frames, brackets, and whatever the printer is currently occupied with.

list.name: Life
list.blurb: A cellular automaton with ambitions. Runs in the browser; download it if you want it to run properly.
list.empty: Notes on the simulation as it develops.

list.name: Overhead
list.blurb: Telescopes, observing notes, and the long end of the same problem: getting light where you need it.
list.intro: Telescopes, observing notes, and the long end of the same problem.
list.empty: The other direction. Optics pointed up instead of down, and notes from whatever the sky over Rhode Island permits on a given night.

list.name: The Void
list.blurb: Ideas, reading, philosophy. The things measurement doesn't settle.
list.empty: Reading, listening, thinking out loud. No particular subject and no particular schedule.
